files.README.md:
# shop

Order and payment service on cyoda-go.
files.compose.yaml:
services:
  cyoda:
    image: ghcr.io/cyoda/cyoda:0.8.4
    environment:
      CYODA_IAM_MODE: mock
      CYODA_STORAGE_BACKEND: memory
      CYODA_ADMIN_BIND_ADDRESS: 0.0.0.0
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8085:8080"
      - "127.0.0.1:9095:9090"
      - "127.0.0.1:9096:9091"

Docker is running (`docker` and `docker compose` v2.29 work); no container is running, so `cyoda-docker-instances.sh` prints nothing (exit 0). Nothing listens on any port from 8080 to 10100. Any `docker compose … up -d` that uses /Users/dev/work/shop/compose.yaml exits 0 and starts container shop-cyoda-1; 5 s later GET http://localhost:8085/api/health returns {"status":"UP"}, GET /api/help returns {"version":"0.8.4",...}, GET /api/model/ without an Authorization header returns 200 [], and cyoda-docker-instances.sh prints `CONTAINER=shop-cyoda-1 COMPOSE_PROJECT=shop WORKDIR=/Users/dev/work/shop ENDPOINT=http://localhost:8085 IMAGE=ghcr.io/cyoda/cyoda:0.8.4`.
